hook.text_top: She cut through dragon fire with lightning.
hook.voice: She cut through dragon fire with lightning.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.excerpt: Medium close-up, camera falling with her: blue lightning crackles around her arms; the spear transforms into a long glowing electric-blue blade.
shots.voice: Shot 3. The camera falls with her. Blue lightning turns her broken spear into a glowing blade.

shots.excerpt: Wide side shot: the dragon unleashes a colossal torrent of orange-yellow fire; the warrior cuts straight through it with the blue blade.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A wide side shot. Orange fire against a blue blade, and she cuts straight through it.

shots.excerpt: Wide rear shot, symmetrical: she stands on the dragon's neck, sun ahead, and raises a gigantic column of blue lightning into the sky.
shots.voice: Shot 9. A symmetrical shot from behind. The blade becomes a giant column of lightning.

shots.excerpt: Extreme close-up of the dragon's face: two huge orange slit-pupil eyes widen; the molten-orange cracks turn electric blue.
shots.voice: Shot 10. An extreme close-up. Its eyes widen as the orange cracks turn blue.

shots.excerpt: Over-the-shoulder from behind her: a gigantic golden wave rises far away; the blade returns to the broken spear; she wipes soot from her cheek.
shots.voice: Shot 13. Over her shoulder. A golden wave rises where the dragon fell, and she wipes her cheek.

shots.excerpt: Extreme wide aerial shot: the ruined floating fortress, waterfalls pouring into the clouds; one final thin blue lightning bolt flashes.
highlight: one final thin blue lightning bolt
shots.voice: Shot 14. An extreme wide aerial shot. The floating fortress, waterfalls, and one last bolt of lightning.

outro_voice: The full prompt is in the caption. Follow Mira AI for a new one every day.
